# 3D asset credits

Acquired 2026-11-14. Original binary files retained; modifications occur only in the renderer.

| File | Source / creator | Catalog | Modification |
|---|---|---|---|
| rover.glb | NASA / Jet Propulsion Laboratory | https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/mars-2020-perseverance-rover/ | Neutral materials replace textures, normalized and enlarged marker scale; body animation only |
| astronaut.glb | DigitalSpace Corporation via NASA | https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/astronaut/ | Neutral materials, normalized marker scale; procedural position bob |

NASA repository README describes assets as free and without copyright; original file is retained in docs/model-terms.txt. Follow https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/ . Do not imply endorsement or repurpose protected insignia. These source assets are not relicensed under the code license.

Node names are saved in *.nodes.json. Rover has a combined Wheels_objs node, so individual wheel rotation is not implemented. Static astronaut model is not a validated biomechanics rig. Habitat/route/uncertainty primitives are original Team 404 code, with the habitat explicitly fictional.

- Ingenuity Mars Helicopter GLB — NASA / Brian E. Kumanchik. https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/ingenuity-mars-helicopter/ . Static reference in mission view.
